errors.RFQ_NOT_DRAFT: This quote request can no longer be edited.
errors.RFQ_EMPTY: A quote request must contain at least one line.

errors.RFQ_ALREADY_CLAIMED: Another account manager is already handling this quote request.
errors.RFQ_EXPIRED: This quote is no longer valid — its validity period has ended. Ask your sales representative for a new quote, or submit the request again.
errors.RFQ_PRICE_PROPOSAL_NOT_ALLOWED: Your account cannot propose prices on quote requests. Remove the proposed prices and send the request again — sales will price it.

errors.QUOTE_VALIDITY_ENDED: The accepted quote is no longer valid — its validity period has ended. Ask your sales representative for a new quote before ordering.
errors.QUOTE_VALIDITY_ENDED.lapsed: The quote these prices were agreed on has expired, so the basket cannot be ordered at them. Ask your sales representative for a new quote, or remove the quoted items from your basket.

errors.QUOTE_VALIDITY_ENDED.unavailable: Prices agreed on a quote cannot be confirmed at the moment, so the basket cannot be ordered at them. Remove the quoted items from your basket to order at current prices.
errors.RFQ_SAVED_VIEW_NAME_TAKEN: You already have a saved view with this name on the quote request list. Choose a different name.
errors.RFQ_SALES_CHANNEL_NOT_ALLOWED: This sales channel is not one of the organization's active sales channels. Choose one of them.
errors.RFQ_SALES_CHANNEL_NOT_ALLOWED.no_: No sales channel to raise this quote request on. Name the sales channel.
errors.RFQ_ALREADY_SHARED: This quote is already shared with the customer.
errors.RFQ_SHARE_CUSTOMER_UNAVAILABLE: This quote cannot be shared: its customer's account cannot receive it.
errors.RFQ_SHARE_CUSTOMER_UNAVAILABLE.no: This quote cannot be shared: its customer's account no longer belongs to the quote's organization.
errors.RFQ_SHARE_CUSTOMER_UNAVAILABLE.in: This quote cannot be shared: its customer's account is inactive.
errors.RFQ_SHARE_CUSTOMER_UNAVAILABLE.bl: This quote cannot be shared: its customer's account is blocked.
errors.RFQ_NOT_SHARED: This quote is not shared with the customer yet. Share it before sending its PDF to the customer.
